maria: FYI PR #4823 touches onprem auth token caching + KMS usage. planning to merge Thu EOD unless SEC raises issues. PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/4823
jess: on it. I'll do a quick security pass tomorrow. pls add checklist: KMS policy tight, no plaintext, audit logs, minimal SA scope, env var scoping, and feature flag

sam: quick question — does this change any VPC egress rules? trying to scope network impact
maria: no new egress, uses existing KMS endpoint in VPC peering. added note in PR description
sec-bot: secret-scan: 0 findings; deps-scan: 1 low - stripe-logger (not directly used)
chris: will run e2e in dedicated staging; ping me when CI green and I can approve
jess: couple items: add audit log retention note + a smoke command snippet for onprem ops
maria: added smoke command:
```
# run on onprem bastion
./bin/smoke-auth --env onprem --token-scope=test
```
maria: pushed last commit; CI queued
chris: CI passed on staging. approving now. :thumbsup:
jess: LGTM from security side. please schedule merge in next quiet window; prefer 11:30am PT tomorrow
maria: ok scheduling 11:30am PT. will notify infra and oncall
sam: thanks all
